laiDetails.initiationProtocol: Test dose 20 mg deep gluteal IM; observe for 5-10 days. Maintenance 20-40 mg every 2-4 weeks (range 20-200 mg every 2-3 weeks). Has activating effect at low dose — sometimes preferred for predominantly negative-symptom presentations.

halfLife.notes: Effective half-life ~17 days. Steady state in ~8 weeks of regular dosing. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

cypInteractions.switchingRelevance: CYP2D6 inhibitors raise levels and worsen EPS. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

lai.notes: This entry IS the LAI. Activating profile — not first choice when sedation is desired.

reboundPsychosisRisk.notes: Long depot tail. Tardive dyskinesia after long-term use is the main concern. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.

formulationNotes: Oily solution (coconut oil/sesame oil derivative vehicle). Deep gluteal IM. Lower volumes preferred — split injections if >2 mL. PENDING_CLINICAL_REVIEW.
